scope: Android client only: pairing, desktop status and Play/Pause/Stop. Reuse existing Compose/manual DI/Coroutines/Jackson/HttpsURLConnection; no new dependency, desktop edit, scanner SDK, server feature, storage migration or push.
restore_limit: Source recovery only, not an Android data or installed APK restore.
pairing_method: Manual paste of desktop pairing text (external scanner copy if supported); not a navigable QR/deep-link and no new camera/scanner SDK.
desktop_name_limit: Protocol exposes no PC name; show honest Desktop + endpoint rather than fabricate one.
network_permission_note: Official current guidance inspected: targetSDK36 or lower retains LAN access through existing INTERNET; do not add Android17 target37 ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK permission for this target. Device acceptance remains separate.
